name: Clown Springtrap Shaco
creator: mava
description:
🎃 Clown Springtrap Shaco
Straight from the twisted carnival of FNaF AR: Special Delivery, Clown Springtrap invades Summoner's Rift for Halloween. This custom mod completely overhauls Default Shaco into a rotting animatronic nightmare with exposed springlocks and bloodied carnival weapons. 🔪

Features
Full custom 3D Clown Springtrap model with rusted endoskeleton details.

Custom bloody pizzeria knife.

Jack in the Box (W): Replaced with an animated Plushtrap.

shadow purple VFX rework.

Distorted SFX and thematic analog audio.

**Replaces: Default Shaco (Skin 0)**


Author: MAVA

Credits: Scott Cawthon / Illumix (Five Nights at Freddy's)
